source_claim: The official VOICEVOX site identifies VOICEVOX as a speech/singing synthesis application and lists multiple named character libraries, while directing users to separate character terms. The checked platform roster establishes VOICEVOX use/library membership but does not establish a shared single HOME Copyright for these eight characters.

checked_routes.result: Official software and library roster checked; platform/library presence does not prove one common Character HOME. Distinct creators and licensing terms remain character-specific; no safe positive relation for the whole multi-member campaign was established.

notes: This records a checked route only. It is not negative HOME evidence and does not terminalize the Research Unit. Existing Issue #180 policy notes that VOICEVOX is a synthesis platform/ecosystem, not a common in-world HOME; further identity/origin work requires character-specific authority.
